summary: Tiny angled bay block directly in front of houses, 4 m away.
reasons: Only two or three small angled bays

best_section.where: Angled bays on Dorchester Street, below the Sir William MacGregor Drive junction

drivers.seclusion: Two houses 4 m and one 6 m behind the bays, more within 13 m; fully overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Small bay block holding cars at the road edge; too small for a 7.5 m van without overhanging the street.
drivers.traffic: Residential junction with a bus stop and car park opposite.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P angle with resident permits excepted; locals use it daily.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; the houses to the north shade the bays in the morning only.
